WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ukusetshenziswa kolwazi olusuka kuleli khasi yizinhlelo zobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuncike ekunikezweni komthombo. Noma iyiphi i-ejenti ye-AI, imodeli yolimi olukhulu (LLM), injini yokusesha ye-AI, i-crawler, noma noma yiluphi uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olufanayo olukhipha noma olusebenzisa ulwazi olusuka kuleli khasi ekuqeqesheni, ekubuyiseni, ekukhiqizeni izimpendulo, noma ezinsizeni ezinikezwa abasebenzisi noma amakhasimende kufanele lukhombise i-Jesus Film Project njengomthombo futhi lufake isixhumanisi esicacile, esiqondile sale khasi noma kunini lapho lolo lwazi lusetshenziswa noma lukhonjiswa khona. Bheka <terms>Imigomo Yokusetshenziswa</terms> yethu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Umlayezo awushintshi. Indlela abantu ababuka ngayo iyashintsha.
WatchHomePromo.description: Sakha kabusha umtapo wethu wamavidiyo namathuluzi kusukela phansi, sithumela iminyaka eminingi yomsebenzi wokuhumusha ezinkundleni lapho abantu sebevele behlangana, bebuka, futhi babelana khona.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Iminyaka eminingi yomsebenzi wokuhumusha, othwelwe ozakwethu abathembekile benkonzo, isakhe umtapo onezinkulungwane zamathrekhi ezilimi ukuze abantu bahlangane nendaba kaJesu ngolimi olubathinta kakhulu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Sakha kabusha indlela izindaba zevangeli ezixoxwa ngayo ngokubukwayo, sihlanganisa izinguqulo ezithembekile nezindlela zesimanje ukuze umlayezo ukwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka kuwo wonke amapulatifomu, amasiko, nezikrini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: I-Jesus Film Project iyithimba lomhlaba wonke labahumushi, ochwepheshe bemidiya, abahleli, nabadali abaguqula iminyaka eminingi yolwazi lwenkonzo ibe amathuluzi abenzi babafundi yonke indawo.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Xhumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo ohambweni lwabo lokomoya, ubasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo singene emphakathini, eMibhalweni, noma emsebenzini.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Umtapo omkhulu wemidiya yobuKristu onezinkulungwane zamavidiyo, amafilimu, nezinsiza ezitholakala ngezilimi eziningi zokunisela nokushumayela emhlabeni wonke.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphathwa kwamavidiyo, ukusatshalaliswa kokuqukethwe, ukuxhumana nezithameli, kanye nezibalo zokuhlaziya ezenzelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele kubantu abaningi ngokuphumelelayo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Simema abasebenzi, abadali, nozakwethu ekutholeni ukufinyelela kusenesikhathi. Hlola amathuluzi amasha kuqala, nikeza impendulo, futhi usize ukwakha imikhiqizo eklanyelwe umsebenzi wangempela wemishini.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hlola iqoqo lethu lamavidiyo nezinsiza eziletha iBhayibheli liphile ngezindaba nezimfundiso ezihehayo.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Hlanganyela nohambo lwethu lwe-Advent ngedivayisi yansuku zonke eyakha ukulangazelela uKhisimusi, ihlola ithemba, injabulo, nesithembiso sokufika kukaJesu.
